outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial tissue image with clusters color-coded (categorical spatial map), not a bar/summary plot of averaged data with variability; individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual region annotations (micrograph/photograph), not a quantitative summary plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel C includes an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue spots. Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement per the check's plot-type exemptions.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots, which are line plots. Line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points because overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Panel E is a bar chart of log2 fold change values (per gene) derived from differential expression analysis, with only p-values annotated and no error bars or individual data points shown to convey the underlying variability of the comparison.
